research_questions.statement: What mechanisms coordinate mechanical forces across compartments to generate tissue architecture during mammalian hair follicle placode formation?

study_units.name: Cell shape and morphological changes during placode formation
experiments_or_tasks: Whole mount imaging of mouse epidermis at E13.5, E14.5, E15.5; segmentation of basal cell shapes; measurement of cell size, elongation, nematic order, and neighbor numbers; use of Edar and Fgf20βGal markers.

datasets.name: Mouse embryo imaging dataset
datasets.description: Images from E13.5 to E15.5 mouse embryos, using Edar and Fgf20βGal markers.

methods.name: Whole mount imaging and 3D segmentation
methods.protocol_description: Confocal z-stacks of mouse epidermis at indicated stages; 3D segmentation of basal cell layer.

results.value_raw_text: At E13.5, Edarhi and Fgf20βGal-positive cells were cuboidal; at E14.5, basal cells elongated longitudinally without volume change; at E15.5, further elongation with basal surface expansion leading to conical shape.

provenance.text_excerpt: Analysis of morphological features revealed that at E13.5, Edarhi and Fgf20βGal-positive cells were still cuboidal in shape... At E15.5, the placode cells continued to further elongate... resulting in a conical shape of E15.5 placode cells.

results.value_raw_text: At E14.5, cells within placodes displayed coordinated centripetal fluctuations and rotational tissue flows; at E15.5, flows not detected but negative divergence indicating out-of-plane tissue flows.

provenance.text_excerpt: Visual inspection and particle image velocimetry (PIV) of live tissue dynamics... indicated that cells within the E14.5 placodes displayed coordinated, collective centripetal fluctuations, as well as rotational tissue flows... At E15.5, the flows were no longer detected, whereas the fluctuations continued and displayed overall negative divergence...

results.value_raw_text: Recoil at placode–epidermis boundary indicated tensile strain; tension inside placode was low.

provenance.text_excerpt: Quantification of recoil and its radial displacement at the placode–epidermis boundary showed that recoil away from the cut occurred on both sides, confirming that this boundary was under tensile strain... In contrast, tension inside the placode itself was low.

results.value_raw_text: pMLC2 higher along apical domain than basal; low within placode, high on apical/suprabasal surfaces.

provenance.text_excerpt: Phosphorylated myosin light chain-2 (pMLC2)... was higher along the apical domain than at the basal... low pMLC2 within the placode and high pMLC2 on the apical/suprabasal surfaces

claims.statement: Placode cell fate specification precedes morphological changes; subsequent elongation is volume-preserving and occurs in two steps.

provenance.text_excerpt: Collectively, these data indicate that the initial placode cell fate determination precedes morphological changes. The subsequent morphological changes are initiated by a volume-preserving elongation of basal cells along the longitudinal axis at E14.5, followed by expansion of the basal surface of the basal cells at E15.5.

claims.statement: Coordinated centripetal and rotational flows drive tissue elongation at E14.5; at E15.5, out-of-plane flows contribute to downward elongation.

provenance.text_excerpt: Cells within the E14.5 placodes displayed coordinated, collective centripetal fluctuations... Examining tissue flows in 3D revealed in-plane contractions positioned at the placode neck, extensile tissue flows downwards to the dermis... resulting in plastic deformation of the placode structure and net downward tissue elongation.

evidence_spans.content: At E13.5, placode cells are cuboidal; at E14.5, cells elongate; at E15.5, further elongate with basal expansion.

provenance.text_excerpt: At E13.5, Edarhi and Fgf20βGal-positive cells were still cuboidal in shape... At E14.5... elongation of the longitudinal axis of the basal cells... At E15.5, the placode cells continued to further elongate... the basal surface expanded.

study_units.name: Role of fibroblast ring and myosin contractility in placode morphogenesis
experiments_or_tasks: Live imaging of dermal fibroblasts; laser ablation of fibroblast ring; conditional knockout of Myh9 in dermal fibroblasts (Myh9-dKO); blebbistatin treatment of skin explants; microfabricated molds and 3D collagen compression assays.

datasets.name: Mouse genetic models and explant cultures
datasets.description: Myh9-dKO mice, skin explants treated with blebbistatin, and in vitro compression experiments.

methods.name: Conditional knockout and explant culture
methods.protocol_description: Twist2-Cre driven Myh9 deletion in dermal fibroblasts; skin explants from E13.5 and E14.5 mice cultured with blebbistatin for 24 h; mitomycin C treatment for 3 h followed by culture.

methods.name: Microfabricated molds and 3D compression
methods.protocol_description: Epidermal progenitor cells cultured on microfabricated molds recapitulating placode invagination; epidermal progenitors in 3D collagen hydrogels subjected to static compression.

results.metric_name: Placode number and morphology in Myh9-dKO
results.value_raw_text: Reduced placode number, reduced invagination, less vertical elongation at E14.5; at E16.5, further reduction in placode number and increased spacing.

provenance.text_excerpt: much fewer placodes... were observed in the Myh9-dKO epidermis at E14.5... Where placodes had formed, they displayed slightly reduced invagination, and cells within these Myh9-dKO placodes were less vertically elongated... This severe defect became even more obvious when the second wave of placode morphogenesis initiated at E16.5, quantified by reduced placode number and increased distance between individual placodes.

results.value_raw_text: More dispersed Sox9 localization; reduced number and density of Sox9-expressing cells; increased average distance from placode center.

provenance.text_excerpt: Myh9-dKO placodes showed an overall more dispersed Sox9 localization... significant reductions in the number and density of Sox9-expressing cells... a significant increase of the average distance of Sox9-positive cells from the centre of the placode... indicative of a failure of Sox9 compartmentalization.

results.value_raw_text: Placodes almost completely failed to develop; Sox9 expression failed to become compartmentalized.

provenance.text_excerpt: when myosin was inhibited in all cells at E13.5, the placodes... almost completely failed to develop... Sox9 expression failed to become compartmentalized into the placode cells at the boundary.

results.value_raw_text: Robust Sox9 expression after 3 h of compression, sustained after 16 h.

provenance.text_excerpt: Robust Sox9 expression was already observed after 3 h of compression, and the effect was sustained after 16 h of compression.

claims.statement: Myosin-IIA activity in dermal fibroblasts is required for placode formation and Sox9 compartmentalization.

provenance.text_excerpt: myosin-IIA activity in the dermal fibroblasts and extrinsic mechanical forces are essential to promote placode formation... Reducing the extrinsic forces... resulted not only in reduced placode formation but also in reduced Sox9 levels and compartmentalization.

claims.statement: Mechanical confinement is sufficient to promote Sox9 expression in epidermal progenitors.

provenance.text_excerpt: To specifically ask whether confinement is sufficient to promote Sox9 expression, we cultured epidermal progenitors in 3D collagen hydrogels and subjected them to extrinsic static compression... Robust Sox9 expression was already observed after 3 h of compression.

evidence_spans.content: Myh9-dKO reduces placode number and Sox9 compartmentalization; blebbistatin blocks placode development; compression induces Sox9.

provenance.text_excerpt: Much fewer placodes... were observed in the Myh9-dKO epidermis at E14.5... Myh9-dKO placodes showed an overall more dispersed Sox9 localization... when myosin was inhibited in all cells at E13.5, the placodes... almost completely failed to develop.

study_units.name: Cell division and YAP activity in placode budding
experiments_or_tasks: Live imaging of Histone2B-mCherry/mEGFP mice; Ki67 staining; YAP inhibition in epidermal progenitors; mitomycin C treatment of explants.

datasets.name: Proliferation and YAP activity dataset
datasets.description: Imaging and quantification from E14.5 and E15.5 embryos and explants.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence and drug treatments
methods.protocol_description: Ki67 and active YAP staining; YAP inhibition in isolated progenitors; mitomycin C treatment for 3 h followed by 24 h culture.

results.value_raw_text: At E14.5, cell divisions more frequent in epidermis than placode; at E15.5, higher divisions in invaginated lower surfaces of placode.

provenance.text_excerpt: cell divisions were substantially more frequent within the epidermis at E14.5, compared to the placode... at E15.5, the most invaginated lower surfaces of the placodes showed higher levels of cell division...

results.value_raw_text: Low active YAP in E14.5 placode; restored in E15.5 placode.

provenance.text_excerpt: This low mitotic frequency in the placode was associated with decreased levels of active nuclear YAP... at E15.5... restoration of nuclear active YAP.

results.value_raw_text: Mitomycin C treatment attenuated placode budding (reduced depth) without affecting diameter.

provenance.text_excerpt: blocking cell divisions at E14.5 did not substantially affect placode diameter, but strongly attenuated budding... quantification of placode depth... reduced placode depth in mitomycin-treated skin explants.

claims.statement: Mechanical confinement at E14.5 represses cell divisions via nuclear YAP exclusion; at E15.5, release of confinement allows YAP activation and cell divisions that promote budding.

provenance.text_excerpt: mechanical confinement of E14.5 placode cells contributed to the repression of cell divisions through nuclear exclusion of YAP... subsequent folding/buckling of the epithelium at E15.5 releases compressive stress on the placode, facilitating YAP activation, cell-cycle re-entry and mitoses, which then enhance efficient budding of the placode.

evidence_spans.content: At E14.5, low Ki67 and low active YAP in placode; at E15.5, increase in both; mitomycin C reduces placode depth.

provenance.text_excerpt: cell divisions were substantially more frequent within the epidermis at E14.5, compared to the placode... at E15.5, the most invaginated lower surfaces of the placodes showed higher levels of cell division... blocking cell divisions at E14.5... strongly attenuated budding.

study_units.name: Basement membrane remodelling and ECM degradation in placode budding
experiments_or_tasks: Immunofluorescence for laminins and collagen IV; atomic force microscopy (AFM) measurement of basement membrane stiffness; single-cell RNA-seq analysis; GM6001 treatment of explants.

datasets.name: Basement membrane and ECM dataset
datasets.description: AFM stiffness data, immunofluorescence, scRNA-seq from E14.5 mouse skin.

methods.name: Atomic force microscopy
methods.protocol_description: Measurement of basement membrane stiffness beneath placode and surrounding epidermis.

methods.name: MMP inhibition
methods.protocol_description: E13.5 skin explants treated with GM6001 for 48 h.

results.value_raw_text: Slightly softer at E14.5, significantly softer at E15.5 beneath placode.

provenance.text_excerpt: measurements of the stiffness of the basement membrane using atomic force microscopy revealed a slightly softer basement membrane beneath the placode at E14.5. This local softening became significantly more pronounced at E15.5.

results.value_raw_text: MMP-2 highly expressed by dermal fibroblasts; MMP-14 enriched in placode and dermal condensate.

provenance.text_excerpt: found the key proteolytic enzyme matrix metalloproteinase (MMP)-2 highly expressed by the dermal fibroblasts, and the membrane bound MMP-14 specifically enriched in the placode as well as in the dermal condensate.

results.metric_name: Placode diameter and depth after GM6001
results.value_raw_text: GM6001 strongly attenuated placode budding, decreased diameter and depth.

provenance.text_excerpt: inhibiting matrix remodelling strongly attenuated placode budding, as visualized by both the decreased diameter and depth of the developing placodes within the explants.

claims.statement: Local basement membrane softening at E15.5 facilitates placode budding, and this softening is mediated by MMP-driven ECM remodelling.

provenance.text_excerpt: ECM remodelling triggered by proteolytic degradation is essential for placode growth by allowing pressure release and subsequent downgrowth.

evidence_spans.content: Basement membrane softer at E15.5 beneath placode; MMP-2 and MMP-14 expressed; GM6001 inhibits budding.

provenance.text_excerpt: measurements of the stiffness of the basement membrane using atomic force microscopy revealed a slightly softer basement membrane beneath the placode at E14.5. This local softening became significantly more pronounced at E15.5... MMP-2 highly expressed by the dermal fibroblasts, and MMP-14 specifically enriched in the placode... inhibiting matrix remodelling strongly attenuated placode budding.

limitations_and_boundaries: Whether the effect of extrinsic forces on Sox9 expression is direct or indirect remains open for future studies.
Additional or compensatory effects from myosin-IIB are possible.
The study does not provide direct evidence for the causal link between mechanical forces and Sox9 expression at the molecular level.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
